reviews.summary: The timed loop invokes the selected CUDA launcher once per -i iteration on each rank's contiguous row slice. Source constructs local CSR delimiters spanning that rank's assigned nonzeros; the device kernel loops its rows and entries, reduces products, and stores outputs. Host disassembly retains the repeated launch loop, and emitted sm_86 SASS for all five Width specializations (1/4/8/16/32) contains sparse loads, DFMA, loop branches, and output stores.

source_evidence.claim: rowBoundary partitions ranks; generateMatrix assigns local CSR intervals and nonzero storage; spmvCuda loops over local rows and CSR entries and stores row outputs; selectLauncher chooses a Width from mean row length; runBenchmark parses -i, computes firstRow/rows, and launches once per iteration within the timed block.

compiled_evidence.claim: The compiled selector maps mean row length to launchSpmv<1/4/8/16/32>; the timed run performs one indirect launch per iteration and branches back until the counter reaches its iteration limit.

These are the emitted sm_86 spmvCuda Width=32,16,8,4,1 specializations; each contains CSR/input LDG operations, DFMA arithmetic, sparse-loop backedges, and output STG instructions. Together they cover every source-dispatched width.
